en: A vintage black‑and‑white (slightly tinted) postcard view of a small town with traditional half‑timbered houses, sloped roofs, a winding road, and a river or stream running through a wooded valley. A solitary person walks along the road in the foreground. At the top left, printed in red, is the title identifying the place, and along the left margin appears the publisher's imprint and number.
